mechanics_change_policy: Any score-, action-, observation-, or simulator-semantic change after this preregistration requires a new contract fingerprint, invalidates all sota-v3 smoke evidence, and re-locks provider spend.

design_amendment.rationale: Pre-data hardening before any v3 smoke or panel evidence exists. Amendment 3 reduced the cohort to eight uniformly reasoning-disabled routes. This amendment preserves that cohort and statistical design, makes cap pressure terminal on its first trigger because the runner did not persist the former one-amendment policy, and distinguishes the generated one-response-per-window planning forecast from the protocol maximum and the dynamically enforced $100 operator ceiling. The generated cost artifact is authoritative; this narrative deliberately does not duplicate its current amount. Scores and apparent model quality played no part: no v3 model data exists.
changes: The eight-model, uniformly reasoning-disabled amendment-3 cohort and Holm family size 8 are retained.
Allocation stays at 16 seeds x 1 repeat with sensitivity power 0.8727, Wilson 95% CI [0.866024, 0.87909], and base power 0.9629.
The generated pre-smoke cost artifact separately reports the planning forecast and protocol maximum, while the runner enforces the $100 ceiling before each provider call.
Cap pressure is terminal for this contract: any truncation or 3,072-token trigger aborts sota-v3 and requires a new preregistration rather than an in-place cap amendment.

statistical_panel_design.primary_claim: Every registered model-plus-compact-scaffold system trails deterministic pick-trader on seed-paired mean lift under the frozen sota-v3 mechanics.
statistical_panel_design.target_effect_basis: Conservative against the frozen sota-v2 observed lifts of -180 to -282 score points at a 0.0 seed win rate for all eight eligible models.
statistical_panel_design.cross_model_covariance: Compound symmetry: one shared residual lift-seed draw per seed; model-by-seed interaction and repeat-averaged noise are independent by model.

selected_allocation.allocation_selection_note: At family size 8 the frozen selection rule's smallest qualifying allocation is 15 seeds x 1 repeat (sensitivity power 0.8357, Wilson lower 0.828309). The panel deliberately retains 16 seeds because seed_panel was already frozen pre-data with a published sha256 and hiding commitment escrowed in the macOS Keychain; breaking a pre-data cryptographic seed commitment to save an estimated $4.53 is a worse trade than running one seed over the floor. 16 seeds is strictly more powerful than the rule's minimum and never less conservative.

statistical_panel_design.selection_rule: Smallest allocation with 9-16 seeds and 1-3 repeats whose conservative-sensitivity familywise-power Wilson 95% lower bound is at least 0.80.

output_policy_amendment_rule: The 4,096-token cap is a symmetric pre-smoke safety ceiling, not a result selected from v3 model behavior. If any accepted-route smoke is truncated or reaches 3,072 output tokens, invalidate every v3 smoke and abort sota-v3 under this contract. Any future run at a different cap requires a new preregistration before model data and a fresh smoke of the full registered family. No in-place cap amendment is permitted, and model score or apparent quality never authorizes a cap change.
blockers: Run exactly one serial strict smoke per registered route at the frozen 4,096-token cap; this is the only currently authorized paid phase.
Mistral Medium 3.5 advertises max_tokens but omits max_completion_tokens metadata, so its request-cap behavior must be established by the strict smoke before any panel authorization.
If any smoke is truncated or reaches 3,072 output tokens, invalidate every v3 smoke, abort this contract, and require a new preregistration before any later run.
Record and accept one strict-fallback smoke for every registered model before separately authorizing panel execution.
